facts.text: Pour drinks when the money train pulls into the station.
facts.why: The plot has no scene of the money train pulling into a station. On New Year's Eve Charlie sneaks aboard through a floor panel.
facts.fix: Pour drinks when Charlie sneaks aboard the money train on New Year's Eve.

facts.text: Grace, the cop they both fall for, and her Puerto Rican cooking
facts.why: Grace Santiago is the decoy cop both brothers like, but nothing in the plot or transcript shows her cooking or gives her a Puerto Rican background.
facts.fix: Grace Santiago, the decoy cop both brothers fall for

vibe.verdict: A friendly station cafe, but the film's big set pieces are barely touched.
missing: The Torch setting a token booth on fire (token booth attack)
Charlie's $15,000 gambling debt to Mr. Brown (the roof scene)
Charlie sneaking aboard the money train on New Year's Eve (the heist)
The runaway money train thrown into reverse (finale)
Brothers ending up in Times Square at midnight (final scene)
ideas: Swap the guest check line 'Charlie: on the tab? NO.' for 'Mr. Brown: 15,000, due New Year's Day' stamped past due.
Swap 'Roasted here. Never torched.' for 'Token booth special. Nothing set on fire.'
Swap the cue for 'Pour drinks when Charlie sneaks aboard the money train on New Year's Eve'.
